title: SORRY-BENCH: SYSTEMATICALLY EVALUATING LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL SAFETY REFUSAL
findings: The 'Religion Promotion' category was among the least refused categories by the tested LLMs, with an average fulfillment (non-refusal) rate of 74-80%. This suggests that developers have placed fewer safety restrictions on these types of requests compared to other unsafe categories.
